title: Quit and Keep Sessions with one idle terminal: 30 s later only that terminal's daemon, its plugin and its host run; the terminal comes back
why: R-LIFECYCLE ORPHANS: Quit and Keep Sessions with an idle terminal keeps exactly what holds that terminal (pty-holder.md D1): the app session's daemon, its screen detection plugin and the terminal's host. On build 3a43a131 the Chief owner and its plugin and the acpmux daemon and router also ran on with parent 1 (the cmux-tui daemon's chat notices watch kept acpmux; nothing kept the Chief owner but no rule stopped it). It expects agents off (the capture slot's default): a working agent keeps acpmux by design.
source: R-LIFECYCLE ORPHANS (handoff/rewrites/R-LIFECYCLE/DESIGN.md section 8), fleet repro rlc-orphans-base-3..6
